svg.aria-label: IDSLab overview in four steps. 1 Configure: data, stages, models and routes in one YAML file, run with idslab run. 2 Fit, then choose on VAL: splits FIT-base, CAL, VAL and a locked TEST; stages binary, router and gate; the router cutoff is chosen by the VAL accuracy of the whole cascade, with off as an option. 3 TEST after the freeze: the cascade against three versions of its first stage alone, plus the controls. 4 Report: cascade minus first stage, frontier gap and stage use; on the synthetic example the cascade ends below its first stage, and the report says so.
